text:
alex: taking primary now for the 23:00 UTC block — quick context: we saw a small embeds latency spike around 22:48 that paged last night but cleared after cache purge. watching for repeats. i'll be primary until 01:30 UTC.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT closed — embeds-high-latency — 22:48–22:52 — assigned to oncall at 22:50 — severity: P2. link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-1823

tess: thanks — are we keeping chen as secondary? @chen

alex: yes, chen stays secondary. runbook pointer: https://runbooks.internal/embeds-latency (see section "night surge quick fixes")

chen: noted. small add: a handful of customers (ticket #12345, #12348) reported 5–8% embed failures during the window. PD alert shows retry loop spike. copying curl from PD: 
```
curl -s https://api.pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2026-1823 | jq '.alerts[] | {service,created_at,status}'
```

sam: on standby for infra if it starts paging. i'll be able to run `kubectl logs -n inference deploy/worker --since=30m` and check gpu mem. ping me if pages repeat. :eyes:

maria: heads-up i'll need to step out 23:45–00:30 for a call. i can extend to 23:55 if needed but can't cover the 00:30–01:30 stretch.

alex: thanks @maria. gap noted 00:30–01:30. i can extend to 01:00 but not past 01:30 due to travel. can someone take 01:30–03:00 primary? ideally fully primary (pager acknowledgement) not shadow.

tess: i can shadow 01:30–03:00 but want to avoid full primary (need to sleep at 02:30).

chen: i can take full primary 01:30–03:00. heads-up i have a planned hotfix deploy at ~02:15 that might need rollback if latency regresses — i'll coordinate with sam ahead of time.

alex: perfect. finalizing handoff: primary schedule now -> alex (23:00–01:30), chen (01:30–03:00). secondary -> tess for whole window. maria off 23:55–00:30. sam standby for infra escalation.

alex: quick handover checklist (copy/paste from runbook):
- :white_check_mark: confirm pager routing: `pagerduty status` -> primary oncall alias
- :white_check_mark: verify KV cache purge script location: `/opt/infra/scripts/purge_kv.sh`
- :arrow_forward: if repeat pages, run `python tools/emit_top_traces.py --since 15m` and attach to INC

chen: i'll own the 02:15 hotfix window and will post deploy time and rollback CMD in this thread prior to execution.

oncall-bot: scheduled rotation: alex -> chen at 167 minutes from thread start. rotation accepted.

pagerduty-bot: reminder: page routing test at 00:00 UTC (silent) — will log to incident.

alex: anyone else see residual errors in logs? i saw some 429s around 22:49 but they're mostly from a single client that retried aggressively. i've DM'd support to throttle customer if needed.

maria: thanks — leaving early but confident with this plan. good luck y'all. :v:
